info.name: dateandtime-api-v2
info.description:
API collection for dateandtime.live v2 API. Each request includes test scripts that verify happy-path responses, plus edge-case variants.

Base URL: https://dt-api-v2-dev.nsura2029.workers.dev

exec: pm.test('Match type is exact or prefix', () => pm.expect(['exact','prefix']).to.include(r.results[0].matchType));
pm.test('All match type is prefix', () => r.results.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.matchType).to.eql('prefix')));
